source_snapshot.test_name_items: Upgrade / Downgrade DCSCM-CPLD firmware by Web when system is off
source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Upgrade / Downgrade DCSCM-CPLD firmware through web UI
(Need to do AC cycle after flash complete).

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.

deepseek_columns.ai_packages_needed: browser/automation to drive the BMC web-UI flash page + DCSCM-CPLD image (user provides)
deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- DCSCM-CPLD upgrade/downgrade via the BMC web UI: the agent first places the exact user-provided DCSCM-CPLD image where the web-UIs upload control expects it, then drives the DCSCM-CPLD flash page (upload image, start update, wait for completion) with host must be powered off first; an AC cycle is required after flash completes; after completion verify the DCSCM-CPLD version. Interactive web-UI upload is not a single sshpass one-liner; walk the UI steps after the image is in place.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return screenshots + the flash-completion status and the DCSCM-CPLD version shown before/after so the user confirms a successful flash and a clean single reset.
deepseek_columns.risk: RISK: DCSCM-CPLD firmware flash via web UI is state-changing and can brick the BMC/host if interrupted; AC cycle after flash is mandatory; flash only the user-specified image and do not interrupt mid-flash.

historical_reviews.gpt_v2: BLOCKED / CHANGED; valuable management-recovery safeguards, while exact images/power parameters remain project readiness inputs.

original_test_intent: Upgrade and downgrade the DCSCM-CPLD through the BMC WebUI with the host off, then apply the required AC cycle and verify the active management-module logic, BMC reachability and host recovery.
original_method: An engineer selects/commits each DCSCM-CPLD image in WebUI, observes terminal state, executes the approved AC activation and verifies DCSCM inventory, management access, host POST/OS and logs.
manual_activity: The engineer performs and observes the WebUI programming core and controls any physical portion of the approved AC-cycle hand-off.
required_inputs: Exact DCSCM hardware/CPLD revision and signed images
DCSCM inventory, management network and host-health expectations
Recovery path independent of the updated DCSCM
safety_requirements: Confirm DCSCM board revision and target CPLD before upload.
Record which management functions may disappear during flash/AC and keep an alternate console or recovery path.
This row requires AC cycle but not necessarily physical cable removal; use the approved project method.
Never automatically retry or repeat AC after uncertainty; preserve WebUI, power, network and SEL evidence.
agent_execution_scope: Prepare board/image evidence, baseline DCSCM/BMC/network/host state, monitor approved power telemetry and collect independent post-AC inventory/reachability/boot evidence.
Do not operate or claim the manual WebUI core and do not assign PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve/perform WebUI transitions and exact AC-cycle hand-off.
Assess DCSCM activation and restored management/host paths, then issue verdicts.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Host-off and AC activation fit, but browser automation does not satisfy manual WebUI acceptance and its clean-single-reset claim is absent from source.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use vendor WebUI manually and an approved AC controller; validate the IPMI raw mapping for this DCSCM-CPLD revision before acceptance.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Host-off, DCSCM WebUI, mandatory AC cycle, script and 5/30-minute values remain.

modernized_recommendation.status: ATTENDED DCSCM-CPLD UPDATE WITH INDEPENDENT MANAGEMENT RECOVERY
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind the image to the exact DCSCM device, capture WebUI completion, perform one controlled AC activation, and verify DCSCM inventory plus BMC/network reachability, host POST/OS and SEL through paths not solely dependent on the updated logic.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: DCSCM-based systems supporting vendor WebUI CPLD programming and AC activation.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record DCSCM hardware/image, BMC/WebUI/browser, IPMI mapping and power-controller versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor DCSCM-CPLD programming, activation, management recovery and rescue documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds board-instance binding, alternate recovery/reachability evidence and controlled power telemetry.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Detects management-plane loss or wrong-device programming after AC, not merely a version string.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Approved DCSCM transition and AC plan.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: If the DCSCM carries management routing, recovery must not depend only on its normal path.

project_override_considerations: Projects may define images, management paths and AC timing/mechanism. Completion is bounded to the exact DCSCM revision and power plan and does not invoke Seq 182 physical removal by default.
expected_evidence: Approved DCSCM board/CPLD/image matrix and hashes
Post-AC DCSCM version, management reachability, BMC/SEL and host POST/OS health
Independent recovery readiness and engineer verdicts

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source consistently targets DCSCM-CPLD through WebUI with host off and AC activation. Versions, management path and power parameters are project inputs; DeepSeek's single-reset phrase is rejected.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The device and lifecycle are understandable. Missing project inputs do not make it permanently blocked; the attended WebUI core is MANUAL ONLY.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Keeps DCSCM/AC scope while rejecting browser substitution and invented reset evidence.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Preserves management recovery controls but changes BLOCKED to MANUAL ONLY.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Adds recovery independence appropriate to a management-module CPLD and retains case-specific AC handling.

review_improvement: Makes restored management connectivity and independent recovery first-class DCSCM acceptance evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: The source defines a coherent attended DCSCM update and activation. Project image/power details can be supplied, but a human must operate and observe the WebUI core; agent automation remains supporting evidence only.
